site.name: NatureLab Reference Plot NL-01, Buitenplaats Oosterwold 178, Almere
site.axes: x = x_local - 35 (east), z = 45 - y_local (north is -z), y up
site.vertical_note: z_nap = height + vertical_offset_m; the window's lowest DTM value is 0

nodata.fill: nearest valid AHN sample (the package's processed grid)
nodata.note: open water has no DTM: the pond and the ditch read as ground at the level of their banks, not as hollows -- their beds are unknown

site.building_height: derived: median(DSM - DTM) inside the outline

rain_scenarios.warning: Synthetic storms are diagnostic scenarios, not statutory Dutch design events.

soil.scope_warning: Regional soil map; not a parcel borehole or foundation investigation.

groundwater_depth_below_ground_cm.scope_warning: 50 m model cell; use as a prior/range, not as an on-site measurement.

site.edges: all four open: water leaves at normal depth on the local ground slope
